claim: A converged periodic Stokes--Brinkman result is differentiated implicitly to eight native, exactly area-preserving Fourier geometry coefficients; the implicit gradient agrees with long-horizon reverse mode, passes a double-precision Taylor test, and drives a projected-gradient descent with an explicit stationarity measure.
